description:
Other points for Tropical cyclone, Cuba, Dominican Republic, Haiti and 1 more, 3 October 2016 (TC20161003HTI): 859 features merged from 7 source layers. Points layers that match none of the named groups. The source layer names below say what each holds. The `source_layer` and `source_file` columns name the layer and file each row came from.

From these HDX datasets:

- [Damage Assessment Overview of Jérémie area, Grande Anse Department](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/damage-assessment-overview-of-jeremie-area-grande-anse-department)
- [Damage Assessment Overview of Tiburon Commune, Sud Department](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/damage-assessment-overview-of-tiburon-commune-sud-department)
- [Damage Assessment of Tiburon town and surroundings](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/damage-assessment-of-tiburon-town-and-surroundings)
- [Haiti - Damage Assessment Overview of Dame Marie and Anse d'Hainault Areas, Grande Anse & Sud Departments](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/damage-assessment-overview-of-dame-marie-and-anse-d-hainault-areas-grande-anse-sud-departments)
- [Preliminary Satellite Based Damage Assessment Report - UPDATE 1: Grand Anse Département, Haiti](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/preliminary-satellite-based-damage-assessment-report-update-1-grand-anse-departement-haiti)
- [Preliminary Satellite Based Damage Assessment Report - UPDATE 3: Grand Anse and Sud Départements, Haiti](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/preliminary-satellite-based-damage-assessment-report-update-3-grand-anse-and-sud-departements-haiti)
- [Preliminary Satellite Based Damage Assessment Report: Grand Anse Département, Haiti](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/preliminary-satellite-based-damage-assessment-report-grand-anse-departement-haiti)

Read [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) for the columns and query recipes.

table:columns.name: Exs
table:columns.description: Coded value. The source geodatabase domain gives: 0 = Unspecified; 1 = Definite; 2 = Doubtful. The decoded text is in `Exs_label`.

table:columns.name: Type
table:columns.description: Coded value. The source geodatabase domain gives: 0 = Unspecified; 1 = Mines / UXO; 2 = Roadblock; 3 = Checkpoint-official; 4 = Checkpoint-unofficial; 5 = Debris; 6 = Wreckage; 7 = Avalanche / Snow; 8 = Flood; 9 = Landslide / Mudslide; 10 = Ford; 11 = Electric lines; 12 = Trees; 13 = Rapids / Cataracts; 14 = Dam; 15 = Sand bank; 16 = Submerged rock; 17 = Road damage; 18 = Railway damage; 19 = Bridge damage; 20 = Culvert damage; 21 = Traffic restriction; 22 = Overhead clearance; 23 = Ferry; 99 = Other (used for labelling). The decoded text is in `Type_label`.

table:columns.name: Opstatus
table:columns.description: Coded value. The source geodatabase domain gives: 0 = Unspecified; 1 = Open; 2 = Restricted; 3 = Closed; 4 = Abandonned/Disused. The decoded text is in `Opstatus_label`.

table:columns.name: CurntPRAC
table:columns.description: Coded value. The source geodatabase domain gives: 0 = Unspecified; 1 = Non-motorized; 2 = Motorbike; 3 = 4WD < 3.5MT; 4 = Light truck < 10MT; 5 = Heavy truck < 20MT; 6 = Truck + Trailer > 20MT. The decoded text is in `CurntPRAC_label`.

table:columns.name: EventCode
table:columns.description: UNOSAT event code (or a Copernicus EMSR id), as recorded on the feature. It does not always equal the code of the event subcatalog.

table:columns.name: CurntPRAC_label
table:columns.description: `CurntPRAC` decoded with the coded-value domain of the source geodatabase. Null where the source had no domain or the code is not in it.

table:columns.name: Exs_label
table:columns.description: `Exs` decoded with the coded-value domain of the source geodatabase. Null where the source had no domain or the code is not in it.

table:columns.name: Opstatus_label
table:columns.description: `Opstatus` decoded with the coded-value domain of the source geodatabase. Null where the source had no domain or the code is not in it.

table:columns.name: Type_label
table:columns.description: `Type` decoded with the coded-value domain of the source geodatabase. Null where the source had no domain or the code is not in it.

table:columns.name: geometry
table:columns.description: Feature geometry, as UNOSAT published it (not repaired).

table:columns.name: source_layer
table:columns.description: Name of the layer in the source file that this row came from.

table:columns.name: source_file
table:columns.description: Name of the file downloaded from HDX that this row came from.

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.type: struct<xmin: double, ymin: double, xmax: double, ymax: double>
table:columns.description: Bounding box of the geometry (xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax), added for spatial filtering.
